evidence: PR #606 reached a green fully-approved head three times (c27e04dd, 57e6b7a7, 4d86ef9d). Each time another PR merged first (#593, #607, #608/#611) it went BEHIND; each refresh produced a new head SHA, invalidating the exact-head risk receipt. Live policy-gate logs on each new head named: risky scope requires exact-head risk approval.
impact: Three extra full CI runs and three human approval round-trips on one PR, plus a fourth refresh before it merged. Cost scales with the number of ready PRs, not with CI speed.
promotion_reason: single non-critical observation; collect another occurrence
suggested_change: Admit exactly one PR at a time into final merge-candidate validation using Builder existing publication path: refresh main, integrate once, validate exact head, merge, then advance the next. Do not build a new queue, scheduler, or merge queue.
summary: Strict up-to-date plus exact-head approval turns parallel green PRs into serial human re-approval.
verified_by: policy-gate job logs 97169216292 and 97170364444; PR #606 mergeable_state BEHIND observed live at three separate heads.
